# Dodo live billing rollout

Mailloop can run in either Dodo `test_mode` or `live_mode`, selected explicitly by
`DODO_PAYMENTS_ENVIRONMENT`. Local development remains in test mode. A database is
bound to one Dodo mode and business; changing its environment variables does not
convert test customers, checkouts, or subscriptions into live ones.

## Before deploying

1. Use a new managed PostgreSQL database for production. Never point Vercel at
   the local Docker database or a database already bound to a test Dodo business.
   Apply migrations with `npm run db:deploy` using the production `DATABASE_URL`.
   The `SystemControl` row is initialized with checkout disabled.
2. Verify the live Dodo product matches the catalog check in
   `src/lib/billing/store.ts`: monthly recurrence, 20-year subscription term,
   USD 599 minor units, one India rule of INR 29900 minor units, tax inclusive,
   no trial, add-ons, discount, or purchasing power parity. Checkout fails closed
   if the product differs.
3. Configure the other production services in `README.md`: Auth.js, Google OAuth,
   Inngest, private Vercel Blob, encryption keys, and billing recovery
   and reconciliation schedules from `docs/dodo-test-billing.md`. Do not set
   `INNGEST_DEV` in production.

## Deploy with checkout off

Set these **server-only** Vercel Production environment variables for the live
Dodo business. Use Vercel's secret settings, never `NEXT_PUBLIC_` or a committed
file:

```text
DODO_PAYMENTS_ENVIRONMENT=live_mode
DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY=[REDACTED_SECRET]
DODO_PAID_MONTHLY_PRODUCT_ID=<live product ID>
DODO_PAYMENTS_BUSINESS_ID=<live business ID>
DODO_PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_KEY=[REDACTED_SECRET]
AUTH_URL=https://mailloop.in
```

The live webhook endpoint must be registered in Dodo live mode as
`https://mailloop.in/api/webhooks/dodo` (replace the domain if production uses a
different canonical domain). The signing secret must come from that live endpoint.
Keep `SystemControl.billingCheckoutEnabled=false` during deployment and webhook
setup. A redirect back to Mailloop is not proof of payment; verified webhook
processing or provider reconciliation grants access.

## Verify and enable

1. Verify sign-in and the production domain, then confirm Dodo can deliver a
   signed live webhook. In Inngest Production, confirm `billing-maintenance` runs
   every four hours, including queued-send cleanup and billing recovery, with reconciliation daily.
   Investigate failed or missing runs before enabling checkout. This job depends
   on Inngest and the Vercel `/api/inngest` endpoint.
2. With a controlled account, verify hosted quotes for India (INR 29900), the US
   (USD 599), and Germany (provider-converted EUR), including the final tax
   presentation. The checkout URL must use `checkout.dodopayments.com` in live
   mode. No test key, product, or webhook secret can be reused.
3. Enable `SystemControl.billingCheckoutEnabled` only after the quote and service
   checks pass. Make one controlled real subscription purchase. Verify webhook
   settlement, paid access, renewal amount, portal access, and cancellation. A
   live test is a real charge. Review refunds and disputes operationally.
4. If checkout fails, disable `billingCheckoutEnabled` first. Keep webhook
   ingress, portal, cancellation, recovery, and reconciliation running to handle
   existing subscriptions and sessions.

The local `npm run db:clear -- --apply` command preserves `SystemControl`,
including the Dodo binding. It is not a way to convert a test database to live.
